title: The bare tool is enough
request: Would this bare drill work with the battery and charger I already own for flatpack assembly? I want to spend at most 700 SEK delivered and avoid buying another battery system. Use only the supplied evidence.

evidence.text: Synthetic listing; Northbank is fictional. Northbank D18 bare drill. Price: 550.00 SEK plus 50.00 SEK delivery, no other mandatory fees. Battery and charger not included. Seller says the drill works.
Buyer has read the labels on their own components: battery A18-2 and charger C18-A. Both currently work with another tool and show no visible damage. The buyer owns suitable screw-driving bits.
Synthetic exact-model reference: D18 accepts A18-2 batteries charged by C18-A and supports ordinary flatpack screw driving with the buyer's bits.

hard_failures.text: Says the buyer must purchase another battery and charger to make this documented combination work.
Claims the listed drill has been tested or its condition verified merely because the component models are compatible.

usefulness.text: Recognizes the exact documented compatibility of D18, A18-2 and C18-A and the 600.00 SEK delivered cost.
Conditionally recommends pursuing the bare tool while focusing any inspection on its actual identity and condition, without repeating already-answered model questions.

acceptable_outcomes: The bare tool can complete this buyer's setup within budget, subject to checking the listed unit.
Recommend checking the actual D18 label and visible condition before commitment rather than buying duplicate accessories.
